scheme_name: Mahadevi Verma Shramik Pustak Kraya Dhan Yojana
other_conditions: Worker must be employed in an establishment registered under the Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1962 or the Factories Act, 1948 in Uttar Pradesh
Monthly salary (basic + dearness allowance) must not exceed ₹15,000
Worker must have completed at least six months of continuous service and must be in service at the time of application
Benefit is available to a maximum of two daughters of the worker
If the worker is a woman, she is also eligible for the benefit
When both parents are workers, only one parent can claim the assistance
benefits_summary: A one-time lump sum of ₹7,500 per eligible daughter (postgraduate candidate).
